Show or choose the release channel hpy updates from

Usage: hpy channel [OPTIONS] [CHANNEL]

Arguments:
  [CHANNEL]  stable (also `main`), beta or alpha. Shows the current channel when omitted

Options:
      --json      Print the result as JSON on stdout
  -y, --yes       Do not ask for confirmation
      --no-input  Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes.
                  Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>        Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help      Print help
